Name: Enhanced Emily (CP)
Author: Akayotic18
Description:
I drew Emily with big eyes like her sister, Haley. I also gave her a new outfit, a cuter face, and longer hair, enjoy!! (:

Sprites can now be changed in the config file, which generates after you run the game once. In the config file, change the word after "Sprite" to "True" for the main sprite with a long, dark blue skirt; "False" for the original unedited sprites; or "Skirt" to give Emily a short, blue skirt. The default is the long, dark blue skirt. Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Change sprite and skirt length in the config file!
